definitions.explanation: The degree of difficulty of a task, test, game, or challenge — especially one that can be rated or compared on a scale.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{難易度|なんいど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This exam has a high difficulty level.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{難易度|なんいど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}べる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: In this game you can choose the difficulty level.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨年|さくねん}→昨年：10433_sakunen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{難易度|なんいど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Compared to last year, the difficulty of the questions is said to have gone up.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{難|なん}→難：00452_nan⟧ (difficult) + {易|い} (easy) + ⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (degree). Functions as a measurement noun — high values mean more difficult.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {難易度|なんいど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ / ⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: high / low difficulty
- {難易度|なんいど}⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧: difficulty setting
- {難易度|なんいど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ / ⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧: difficulty rises / falls
- {難易度|なんいど}⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧: by difficulty level

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {難|むずか}しさ: difficulty (general feeling) — {難易度|なんいど} is measured/rated; {難|むずか}しさ is more subjective
- ⟦レベル→レベル：00352_reberu⟧: level — overlaps for games but lacks the difficult/easy axis built into {難易度|なんいど}
